# MayoTechX

> MayoTechX is a global, remote-first technology company founded by Nadeem Mayo. It provides SEO, link building, digital PR, Google/Meta/TikTok ads, web, WordPress and e-commerce development, custom software and SaaS, mobile apps, UI/UX design and AI chatbots & automation for brands worldwide. Contact: nadeemonlin@gmail.com · WhatsApp +92 307 4646927.

## Guides
- [How Much Does SEO Cost in 2026? Pricing Models Explained](https://mayotechx.com/blog/how-much-does-seo-cost.html): What SEO really costs in 2026: retainers, projects, hourly and per-link pricing, what drives the price, and how to judge whether a quote is good value.
- [Guest Posting in 2026: How to Build Links That Still Move Rankings](https://mayotechx.com/blog/guest-posting-guide.html): A practical guide to guest posting in 2026: how to choose publishers, metrics that matter, anchor text, content quality and how to avoid links that hurt.
- [Google Ads vs Meta Ads: Where Should Your Budget Go?](https://mayotechx.com/blog/google-ads-vs-meta-ads.html): Google Ads captures demand; Meta Ads creates it. Learn when to use each, how budgets usually split, and how to measure both properly.
- [How to Get Cited in AI Search: Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT & Perplexity](https://mayotechx.com/blog/ai-search-optimisation.html): How AI search engines choose which brands to cite, and the practical steps — content, structure, authority and technical — to be included in AI answers.
- [How to Choose a Software Development Partner: 12 Questions to Ask](https://mayotechx.com/blog/choose-software-development-partner.html): Twelve questions to ask before hiring a software development company — covering process, ownership, security, communication, pricing and support.
- [AI Chatbots for Business: What They Can (and Can’t) Do](https://mayotechx.com/blog/ai-chatbots-for-business.html): A practical look at AI chatbots for websites and WhatsApp: realistic use cases, limits, costs, data privacy and how to launch one that customers actually use.
